# Label provenance counts: summary (local observation of the downloaded files)

- PTB-XL: `results/label_provenance_counts_ptb_xl.csv`, 40 SCP codes in scope (MI codes, STE_/STD_/NST_, ISC*, and the codes behind the 21 crosswalk labels).
- CODE-15%: `results/label_provenance_counts_code15.csv`; no column records label origin (origin_column_found = False).

## PTB-XL whole file: validated_by_human x initial_autogenerated_report (ECGs)

| validated_by_human | autogenerated False | autogenerated True |
|---|---|---|
| False | 0 | 5743 |
| True | 14986 | 1070 |

Observation: every ECG with validated_by_human = False has an autogenerated initial report (non-validated ⊂ autogenerated; holds), but 1,070 autogenerated ECGs are human-validated, so the two sets are not equal.

Observation only (no cause is stated by any source): 12 codes never occur on an autogenerated ECG: EL, HVOLT, INVT, LOWT, LPR, NT_, PRC(S), QWAVE, STD_, STE_, SVTAC, TAB_.
